title: Mint Julep
nutrition_tip: A mint julep is made with Kentucky bourbon, sweetened with simple syrup, and ser…

ingredients.name: 0.5 cup roughly chopped fresh mint leaves
8 cups crushed ice, or as needed

steps.text: Make the simple syrup ahead of when you plan to serve: Bring water, sugar, and chopped mint to a boil over high heat in a small saucepan.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until sugar is completely dissolved, 1 to 2 minutes. Remove from the heat and let cool .
Pour syrup through a strainer to remove mint leaves.
To make the mint juleps: Fill eight glasses with crushed ice; pour 4 ounces bourbon and 1/4 cup mint syrup into each cup.
Top each drink with a mint sprig.
